prompt_record.text: The attached image is the accepted STYLE anchor. Make a new quiet editorial workflow illustration matching its graphite hand-drawn outlines, soft flat warm-ivory fills, faint paper grain, muted cyan and desaturated rose accents, restrained amber light, raised front three-quarter view and very light warm-grey background. 4:3 landscape, compact subject centred slightly above middle, calm empty bottom third for a real HTML caption. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI controls or people. Subject for workflow-review: a large standing picture frame holding an original simple abstract landscape, beside a neutral paper checklist motif with four EMPTY square boxes and four plain horizontal rules. No ticks or crosses in any box. The meaning is human inspection awaiting decisions, never automatic approval. No stamps, badges, letters or rating.
